WITH /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.ComCodeMapper.selectComCodeList(공통코드조회) */ V_CMMNS_CD AS ( SELECT T21.CMMNS_CD_ID AS CMMNS_CD_ID -- 공통코드아이디 , T21.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE -- 공통코드값 , T21.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM -- 공통코드값명 , T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 -- 추가관리값1 , T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 -- 추가관리값2 , T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 -- 추가관리값3 , T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 -- 추가관리값4 , T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 -- 추가관리값5 , CASE WHEN T21.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = '0' THEN NULL ELSE T21.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE END AS UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE -- 상위공통코드값 , T21.SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE -- 정렬순서 , T21.USE_YN AS USE_YN -- 사용여부 FROM SAC100 T21 /* 공통코드값 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T21.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CMMNS_CD_ID} -- 공통코드아이디
AND T21.CMMNS_CD_VALUE LIKE '%' || #{CMMNS_CD_VALUE} || '%' -- 공통코드값
AND T21.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM LIKE '%' || #{CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM} || '%' -- 공통코드값명
AND T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 LIKE '%' || #{ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1} || '%' -- 추가관리값1
AND T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 LIKE '%' || #{ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2} || '%' -- 추가관리값2
AND T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 LIKE '%' || #{ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3} || '%' -- 추가관리값3
AND T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 LIKE '%' || #{ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4} || '%' -- 추가관리값4
AND T21.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 LIKE '%' || #{ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5} || '%' -- 추가관리값4
AND NVL(T21.USE_YN,'N') = #{USE_YN} -- 사용여부
ORDER BY T21.SRTNG_SQNCE ) , V_CMMNS_CTPV AS ( SELECT DISTINCT 'CTPV_SE_CD' AS CMMNS_CD_ID -- 공통코드아이디 , SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE -- 공통코드값(시도코드) , T21.CTPV_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM -- 공통코드값명(시도명) , NULL AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 -- 추가관리값1 , NULL AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 -- 추가관리값2 , NULL AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 -- 추가관리값3 , NULL AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 -- 추가관리값4 , NULL AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 -- 추가관리값5 , NULL AS UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE -- 상위공통코드값 , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '11' THEN 1 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '26' THEN 2 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '27' THEN 3 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '28' THEN 4 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '29' THEN 5 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '30' THEN 6 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '31' THEN 7 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '36' THEN 8 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '41' THEN 9 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '42' THEN 10 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '43' THEN 11 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '44' THEN 12 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '45' THEN 13 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '46' THEN 14 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '47' THEN 15 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '48' THEN 16 WHEN SUBSTR(T21.SGG_CD,1,2) = '50' THEN 17 ELSE 99 END AS SRTNG_SQNCE -- 정렬순서 , CASE WHEN NVL(T21.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_YN -- 사용여부 FROM SAA020 T21 /* 시군구코드 */ WHERE 1 = 1
AND NVL(T21.DEL_YN,'N') != #{USE_YN} -- 사용여부
) , V_CMMNS_LIST AS ( SELECT T11.* FROM V_CMMNS_CD T11 WHERE 1 = 1 UNION SELECT T12.* FROM V_CMMNS_CTPV T12 WHERE 1 = 1 ) SELECT T1.CMMNS_CD_ID AS CMMNS_CD_ID -- 공통코드아이디 , T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE -- 공통코드값 , T1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM -- 공통코드값명 , T1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 -- 추가관리값1 , T1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 -- 추가관리값2 , T1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 -- 추가관리값3 , T1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 -- 추가관리값4 , T1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 AS ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 -- 추가관리값5 , T1.UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE -- 상위공통코드값 , T1.SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE -- 정렬순서 , T1.USE_YN AS USE_YN -- 사용여부 FROM V_CMMNS_LIST T1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CMMNS_CD_ID} -- 공통코드아이디 ORDER BY T1.SRTNG_SQNCE
